accuracy.title: How accurate is Google Maps for these bus stops?
accuracy.intro: A full check comparing the locations Google Maps shows against the official coordinates published by the Kagoshima City Transportation Bureau, for all 20 City View bus stops.
accuracy.sameSpot: No. 1 and No. 20 are the same location (Kagoshima-Chuo Station).
accuracy.baseline: The baseline coordinates used for comparison were verified to match the official values published by the Kagoshima City Transportation Bureau for all 20 stops (verified 2026-07-20).
accuracy.method: Method: for each stop's Japanese name, we searched Google Maps and measured the distance (haversine) between the top candidate and the official coordinates. Under 50m is within smartphone GPS error ('OK'); 100m or more is graded 'Wrong'.

back.title: Getting back
back.generic: The bus loops in one direction. Board at any stop and it returns to Kagoshima-Chuo Station (No.20), about {{min}} min per loop. To get off near your hotel, the return stop may differ from the one you boarded at (e.g. Tenmonkan: No.3 out, No.19 back).
back.hotel: On the way back, get off at No.{{num}} {{name}} (about {{min}} min walk to the hotel).

fare.title: Fare
fare.note: Cash and transit IC cards accepted; day passes are sold on board. Check the official site for the latest fares.

partnership.body: Guests scan the QR code to see the exact location of every stop on their phone. Print files are free, and we can add your property’s name. Available in Japanese, English, Korean and Traditional Chinese.
partnership.aboutBody: Born from a traveler who missed the bus in Kagoshima. Built and run by MAKORO.
partnership.aboutMaintenance: We re-verify all stop locations quarterly and publish the results

problem.title:
Google Maps is wrong,
and there are no signs
problem.item1: Google Maps points to the wrong location. One traveler waited 10 minutes and missed the bus.
problem.item2: Multilingual guidance at stops is limited. Some foreign travelers didn't know whether to board when the bus arrived.
problem.item3: Accurate multilingual info in one place is hard to find. This app fills that gap.

home.spotsLead: The City View bus leaves Kagoshima-Chuo Station, circles {{count}} stops and comes back to the station. Here are a few places worth hopping off for.
home.routeRailLabel: {{count}} stops on the City View route

saigo.title: Saigō Takamori Statue
saigo.body: A statue honoring Saigō Takamori, a leading figure of the Meiji Restoration, at the foot of Shiroyama beside Central Park.

shiroyama.title: Shiroyama Observatory
shiroyama.body: A lookout on a hill about 107 m high, with the city, Kinko Bay and Sakurajima all in one view.

senganen.title: Sengan-en
senganen.body: The Shimazu family garden villa, which borrows Sakurajima as its mountain and Kinko Bay as its pond.

ferry.title: Sakurajima Ferry
ferry.body: The ferry terminal is right by the Aquarium stop. Sakurajima is about 15 minutes away by ferry.

home.tickerNextBus: See how many minutes until the next bus

seo.description: Exact locations of all 20 Kagoshima City View bus stops on a map, with walking directions from your hotel and minutes to the next bus. Japanese, English, Korean and Traditional Chinese. Free, no app needed.
seo.mapDescription: Exact GPS locations of all 20 Kagoshima City View stops. Tap a stop for its timetable and minutes to the next bus.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: The address may have changed or been mistyped. Try the bus stop map.

desk.title: Front Desk Interpreter
desk.intro: Type the guest’s question in Japanese and get an answer in the guest’s language. Stops, times and fares come only from this site’s data; anything else is answered with “I don’t know”.
desk.placeholder: e.g. 仙巌園に行きたいそうです。どこで乗って、帰りは何時までですか？
desk.qrLabel: QR code for the map from this hotel
desk.qrCaption: Map the guest can open on their phone
desk.notConfigured: This feature is not set up yet (it works once the operator adds the AI configuration). The stop info and map QR above work as usual.

desk.disclaimer: Times are timetable estimates. This answer was written by AI; stops, times and fares are based on the site’s data.
